page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor architecture. The platform is driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Compute capacity consists of 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 512 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. This configuration is engineered specifically to support computational tasks where system memory capacity is the primary constraint.

The instance does not bundle local ephemeral storage, meaning all persistence requirements must be handled via network-attached cloud storage volumes. GPU acceleration is also absent, focusing the server entirely on CPU and memory operations. Network connectivity provides a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, offering consistent throughput for high-volume data ingest, inter-node clustering, and distributed system operations.

Resource allocation efficiency is optimized for memory-bound workloads rather than IOPS-heavy scratchpad tasks. With high memory density per core, the server presents a balanced operational profile for in-memory databases, distributed caching layers such as Redis or Memcached, big data processing frameworks, and enterprise-grade relational database management systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. Configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512 GB of system memory, the instance delivers an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio tailored for data-heavy applications requiring large memory pools. It lacks integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent disks, and includes no discrete GPU hardware. Network capabilities include a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating substantial throughput across distributed environments. By prioritizing a high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated compute allocation without bundled local NVMe storage or graphics hardware, the instance provides efficient resource consolidation for in-memory databases, large caching layers, memory-bound enterprise software, and large-scale data processing pipelines.
